meta.description: Bayer and Flamsteed designations by Hipparcos number, for the stars of the finder file (Vmag <= 7.5). Generated by `npm run stars:designations` from the raw responses of the sources below; never edit by hand (scripts/data/star-designation-overrides.json is the hand-edited input).

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.properties: P528 catalog code with qualifier P972 catalog: Q537199 Hipparcos Catalogue, Q105616 Bayer designation, Q111116 Flamsteed designation; English item labels where P528 gives a kind nothing

sources.name: Hipparcos Catalogue V1 positions (constellation filter only)
sources.note: Positions give each star's constellation; no Hipparcos value is stored in this table.

queries.designations: SELECT ?hip ?value ?catalog WHERE { VALUES ?catalog { wd:Q105616 wd:Q111116 } ?s p:P528 ?hs . ?hs ps:P528 ?hip ; pq:P972 wd:Q537199 . ?s p:P528 ?ds . ?ds ps:P528 ?value ; pq:P972 ?catalog . }
queries.labels: SELECT ?hip ?label WHERE { ?s p:P528 ?hs . ?hs ps:P528 ?hip ; pq:P972 wd:Q537199 . ?s rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(LANG(?label) = "en") FILTER(REGEX(?label, "^((Alpha|Beta|Gamma|Delta|Epsilon|Zeta|Eta|Theta|Iota|Kappa|Lambda|Mu|Nu|Xi|Omicron|Pi|Rho|Sigma|Tau|Upsilon|Phi|Chi|Psi|Omega)[0-9]?|[0-9]+) [A-Z][A-Za-zëö]+( [A-Z][a-z]+)?$")) }

rules: Values are Greek-letter Bayer (three-letter abbreviation, superscript digits as -n) and Flamsteed numbers; Latin-letter and component-letter values are dropped.

A value is kept only when its constellation suffix equals the constellation computed (astronomy-engine Constellation, J2000) from the star's own Hipparcos position; Wikidata's coordinates are never used.

Several different values in the computed constellation, or none in it, mean the value is omitted rather than guessed, unless an entry in star-designation-overrides.json gives the value or omit: true with a citable source.
English item labels ("Beta2 Capricorni", "30 Sagittarii") are read only for a kind the item has no catalogue-code value of at all, and go through the same rules.

A Flamsteed value that is really a Gould number (Uranometria Argentina; the southern stars of Carina, Vela, Puppis, Chamaeleon and Circinus with numbers above Flamsteed's range) or that SIMBAD does not know is omitted by an entry in star-designation-overrides.json that says why.
Each tuple is [bayer, flamsteed]; null means none. HYG is never read.
